def shapes(grid):
    # find connected shapes (4-conn, same color) in bottom area, sorted by leftmost col
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):

                col=grid[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                seen.add((i,j))
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b))
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen:
                            seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
                out.append((col,comp))
    out.sort(key=lambda s: min(j for _,j in s[1]))
    return out
